description: Invalid MT103 missing mandatory field 32A (Value Date/Currency/Amount)
validation_rules_expected_to_fail: Field 32A is mandatory and must be present

missing_field.name: Value Date/Currency/Interbank Settled Amount
missing_field.description: This field specifies when the payment should be settled (value date), the currency, and the amount to be transferred. It is mandatory in all MT103 messages.

error_expected: Missing mandatory field :32A: - MT103 message must include value date, currency, and amount
notes: This test case validates that parsers correctly detect missing mandatory fields. Field 32A is one of the four mandatory fields in MT103 (along with 20, 23B, 50, 59, 71A). Without it, the message is structurally invalid and should be rejected during parsing or validation. A real-world scenario might be a malformed message due to transmission errors or incorrect message construction.
